policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="hmacOk" value="@{
        var tsHeader = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-Timestamp", "");
        var sigHeader = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-Signature", "");
        long ts;
        if (!long.TryParse(tsHeader, out ts)) { return false; }
        var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds();
        if (Math.Abs(now - ts) > 300) { return false; }   // replay window: 5 minutes
        if (!sigHeader.StartsWith("sha256=")) { return false; }
        var provided = sigHeader.Substring(7).ToLowerInvariant();

        var body = context.Request.Body != null ? context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true) : "";
        var payload = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(tsHeader + "." + body);
        var secrets = new [] { "{{webhook-secret-primary}}", "{{webhook-secret-secondary}}" };

        var ok = false;
        foreach (var secret in secrets) {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(secret)) { continue; }
            string expected;
            using (var h = new System.Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA256(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(secret))) {
                expected = BitConverter.ToString(h.ComputeHash(payload)).Replace("-", "").ToLowerInvariant();
            }
            // Constant-time compare (no early exit on mismatch).
            var diff = expected.Length ^ provided.Length;
            for (var i = 0; i < expected.Length; i++) {
                diff |= expected[i] ^ (i < provided.Length ? provided[i] : 0);
            }
            ok |= diff == 0;   // evaluate both secrets regardless of result
        }
        return ok;
    }" />
    
      
        
          
        
      
    
    
      true
